- Project: primesync.me
- Project-designated MCP endpoint: `https://ai.primesync.me/mcp/v1`
PrimeSync AI Studio helps a connected AI work on strategy and indicator design, preservation of exis
ting logic, TradingView trade-export analysis, optimization, and Monte Carlo research.
This repository contains public documentation and an experimental DeepSeek Harness configuration bun
dle. It does not contain the hosted server implementation or proprietary PrimeSync trading scripts.
## Start here

1. Follow the connection guide.
2. Read the capabilities and tool reference.
3. Choose an example re

quest.
4. Follow the research workflow.
5. Review privacy and security and verification status.
## DeepSeek Harness preview
An installable preview is available for DeepSeek Harness. Read the setup and verification guide befo
re installing. Full customer OAuth sign-in and end-to-end tool execution remain unverified; this is
not a DeepSeek endorsement or a production compatibility claim.
## Scope and limitations
The connected tool declaration says it does not execute submitted code, contact brokers, place trade
s, or store strategy code. These are interface declarations, not independently audited guarantees.
Backtests must be run in a suitable external environment. Generated code and proposed improvements n
eed validation before use. Research results do not guarantee future trading performance.
## Documentation status
Prepared on 2026-09-12 from the PrimeSync AI Studio tool declaration exposed to the documentation se
ssion. Endpoint availability, OAuth behavior, runtime outputs, and the server implementation were no
t verified. See the verification record for the exact evidence boundary.
